parameters.query:
with day as (
  select date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc' as start
)
select
  count(*) filter (where q.ip = $1::inet or q.client_id = nullif($2, '')::uuid) as ip_today,
  count(*) as system_today,
  (select max(created_at) from quota_log
     where ip = $1::inet or client_id = nullif($2, '')::uuid) as ip_last,
  (select start from day) + interval '1 day' as resets_at
from quota_log q, day
where q.created_at >= day.start;
insert into quota_log (ip, client_id) values ($1::inet, nullif($2, '')::uuid) returning id;

parameters.query:
insert into recipes (title, cooking_time_minutes, cooking_time, cuisine, diet, portions, cooks, nutrition, ingredients, steps)
select
  e->>'title',
  (e->>'cookingTimeMinutes')::int,
  e->>'cookingTime',
  e->>'cuisine',
  e->>'diet',
  (e->>'portions')::int,
  (e->>'cooks')::int,
  e->'nutrition',
  e->'ingredients',
  e->'steps'
from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) with ordinality as t(e, ord)
order by ord
returning id, likes;
